class_id: an upsert keyed on a column narrower than the row's purpose overwrites an open row of a different kind
feature: any writer that finds-or-refreshes an open row by a coarse key (ipo + table + row + field) while the same table also holds rows with a different purpose (reason) on that key -- admin-only queue items, corrigendum suggestions, hold rows, source-vs-source disputes
symptom: a table holds several kinds of open row that share one key, distinguished only by a reason column. A writer upserts or auto-resolves by the key alone, so it matches a row of a kind it was never meant to touch and rewrites or closes it. The row changes purpose silently: an admin-only queue item is refreshed into a source dispute (or closed as 'converged'), so it vanishes from the queue it was meant to sit in, and the alert path for the new kind fires (the owner is paged) for something that was never a dispute. No error, no failing count: the write succeeds and every per-row check passes, because each row is individually valid. Universal shape: a find-or-update whose WHERE clause omits the discriminator column is a cross-kind overwrite waiting for the second kind of row to exist on the same key.
first_seen: 2026-09-30 -- IPODhan PR #1327 (OD-142 / OD-144), found by the real-walk integration proof (scraper/tests/integration/od144-plan-rank-write.integration.test.ts) on the Mopshop-shaped correction: after a type correction queued an open SOURCE_NO_LONGER_FIRST item for a field, the scraper's `upsertConflict` in packages/shared/src/repositories/data-conflicts-repository.ts matched that open row by (ipo, table, row, field), refreshed it, and it became a HELD_DISPUTED_HIGH_VALUE_LIVE dispute; the queue item disappeared and the owner would have been paged. The sibling `autoResolveConverged` update used the same key and would likewise have closed the item when two sources converged. A 5-param SQL assertion in scraper/tests/unit/repositories/data-conflicts-repository.test.ts now pins the added discriminator
